actualBoundedOfficialRead.ownParaphrase: The NTG year-11 clause asks reasoning about inherited or acquired digestion/uptake differences. The polarimetry clause uses specific rotation for bounded characterisation and identification, with instrument function and Biot relation in the content list.
actualBoundedOfficialRead.scope: Only these literal contributions; no whole BY release, course equivalence, or other jurisdiction approval.

primaryScienceReads.ownParaphrase: The NIH institute describes reduced intestinal lactase and impaired lactose digestion. It distinguishes genetic contributions from secondary reduction after intestinal injury.
primaryScienceReads.useBoundary: Mechanism plausibility only. These external examples are not silently inserted into the existing learner cases, and no individual diagnosis is inferred.

primaryScienceReads.ownParaphrase: The textbook derives specific rotation from measured angle divided by path length and concentration, and describes equal opposite enantiomer rotations. Its tables label the referenced quantity as specific rotation even where conventional units are suppressed.
primaryScienceReads.useBoundary: Distinguishes alpha from bracket-alpha. No textbook task, image or full text is copied.

primaryScienceReads.ownParaphrase: The glossary separately identifies observed alpha, specific bracket-alpha, path in dm and concentration in g/mL.
primaryScienceReads.useBoundary: Quantity/convention check only; degrees alone can be conventional shorthand when a quantity is explicitly labelled specific rotation.
